messages:
zoe kim: Quick sync  we need a single place to track codemods + banner copy for the v1->v2 deprecation. Freeze snippets Wed 5pm PT. Who can run the codemod and watch the PR queue?
ben roberts: I can run the JS/TS codemod and open a PR with the changes. Plan: codemod will replace `client.completions` and `models.createCompletion` with the new `responses.create` pattern and add a short comment showing the shim.
maya singh: I'll take Python and Go codemods. Also will add unit-test hints in the migration guide for asserting no 422 errors after index swap.
zoe kim: Perfect. Can we also add an in-doc snippet showing both patterns side-by-side and a one-click copy button for the new form? UX wants that for the banner preview.
ben roberts: Yup. Codemod will also insert a TODO comment that says: "remove legacyCompat after 90 days" and wire up a small release note reference. We'll include a codemod dry-run example in the PR description.
ops-bot: tenancy-service: pinned-route option enabled for Dedicated tenants on request. Contact ops+dedicated@redwood.ai.
maya singh: Ops: can Dedicated keep pinned v1 for up to 30 days?
ops-bot: tenancy-service: pinned-route retention limit: 30 days (manual approval required).
zoe kim: Docs CI: please make a preview page for the migration guide and the banner text so Product can review tone.
docs-ci: docs-ci: PR #4507 (migration/codemods-and-banner) opened by @ben-roberts  preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/migration/v1-to-v2-codemod  lint ok.
ben roberts: Sample codemod dry-run output included in PR:
```json
{
  "file": "examples/js/chat.js",
  "changes": [
    {"line": 12, "from": "client.completions.create(...)", "to": "responses.create(...)"}
  ]
}
```
maya singh: Adding a short rollback section: revert codemod PR, re-run tests, restore pinned v1 route if needed, contact support. Also adding a small checklist for customers: backup indices, run `redwood-migrate --dry-run`, validate recall, update snippets, remove shim after verifications.
zoe kim: Great. I'll draft banner copy and a short in-product toast: "Deprecation: v1 client and select models will be retired on <date>. See migration guide." Will add links to the PR.
ben roberts: Once codemods finish, I'll assign reviewers and queue merges in small batches to avoid huge diffs. Will ping here when first PR lands.
zoe kim: Thanks team. Please tag @product and @support in PR descriptions. We'll flip the banner after doc merges and a final QA pass.
